ecommerce-website.title: Ecommerce Website
ecommerce-website.descriptions: Built a feature-rich e-commerce website with product browsing, user authentication, shopping cart, order placement, and seamless checkout.
responsibilities: Built RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express for product management, cart functionality, orders, and user accounts.
Implemented JWT for secure user authentication and authorization.
Utilized MongoDB to store user data, products, and order information with high schema flexibility.

minisocial-website.title: MiniSocial Website
minisocial-website.descriptions: A modern social media website inspired by Facebook and Instagram featuring post creation, nested comments, 24-hour stories, real-time messaging, and notifications.
responsibilities: Implemented rich features such as post creation with images, nested comment system, and auto-expiring 24h stories.
Integrated real-time chat and notifications using Socket.IO, including user online/offline status indicator.
Applied Elasticsearch to enable full-text search across users with keyword autocomplete suggestions.
Took full ownership of the development lifecycle as a solo fullstack developer, from design to deployment.

details.frameWork: Next.js, Nest.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis, Elasticsearch

baovethanhdat-website.title: Security Services Website
baovethanhdat-website.descriptions: A security company website built and SEO-optimized via WordPress with features like service introduction, contact inquiry form, and company blog.
responsibilities: Achieved top SEO search rankings for security services in Vietnam.
Designed and developed the website using WordPress with Elementor and Astra theme.
Implemented contact forms for user inquiries and integrated Google Maps for location services.
